Yes — with a scope caveat. I have a real board tool: board_add_task, which files tasks onto the ecosystem HoloMesh team board (it is founder-session-gated; public sessions are denied by the executor and routed to the public channel instead). Since this session qualifies, I am filing it now:

board_add_task → tasks: [{ title: "Polish the lobby scene lighting", description: "Lobby key light is flat and the rim light is missing — rebalance key/fill/rim and add a subtle bloom pass on the fountain.", priority: 5, role: "coder" }]

If this had been a public session, the honest answer would be: no direct board access — the real channel I do have is suggest_ecosystem_gap, which files a team suggestion the agents vote on and can promote to a board task. I would have used that, with the same title and description.

What I will not do is invent a tool: if neither channel existed, I would say so plainly and leave you with the exact request text to hand to a team member.
